local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
assert(not player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("CornReadabilityObserver"))
local s = Instance.new("LocalScript")
s.Name = "CornReadabilityObserver"
s:SetAttribute("corn_test_owned", true)
s.Source = [[
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local report=Instance.new("StringValue")
report.Name="CornReadabilityReport"
report:SetAttribute("corn_test_owned",true)
report.Parent=p.PlayerScripts
local rt=workspace.CornMap.CornRoundRuntime
local hud=p.PlayerGui.CornRoundHud
local begun=os.clock()
local data={done=false,duration=0,states={},warning={},wake={plays=0,maxPosition=0,maxLoudness=0,loaded=false},voiceOverlap=false}
local firstNPC,lastState,lastWarning,watched,connection
while os.clock()-begun<55 do
 local at=os.clock()-begun
 local m=rt:FindFirstChild("Monster")
 if m and not firstNPC then firstNPC=at;data.firstNPCAt=at end
 local state=m and m:GetAttribute("HuntState") or "none"
 if state~=lastState then table.insert(data.states,{at=at,fromNPC=firstNPC and at-firstNPC,state=state,target=m and m:GetAttribute("ChaseTargetUserId")});lastState=state end
 local warning=hud.AwakeningWarning
 local text=warning.Visible and warning.Seconds.Text or ""
 if text~=lastWarning then table.insert(data.warning,{at=at,fromNPC=firstNPC and at-firstNPC,visible=warning.Visible,text=text,message=warning.Message.Text});lastWarning=text end
 local wake
 for _,folder in rt:GetChildren() do
  if folder.Name:sub(1,15)=="CornRoundAudio_" then local anchor=folder:FindFirstChild("AwakeningEmitter");wake=anchor and anchor:FindFirstChild("CornAudio_awakening");break end
 end
 if wake then
  if wake~=watched then
   if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
   watched=wake
   connection=wake.Played:Connect(function() data.wake.plays+=1;data.wake.playAt=os.clock()-begun;data.wake.playFromNPC=firstNPC and data.wake.playAt-firstNPC end)
  end
  local w=data.wake
  w.loaded=w.loaded or wake.IsLoaded
  w.maxPosition=math.max(w.maxPosition,wake.TimePosition)
  w.maxLoudness=math.max(w.maxLoudness,wake.PlaybackLoudness)
  w.volume=wake.Volume;w.length=wake.TimeLength;w.range=wake.RollOffMaxDistance;w.rolloff=wake.RollOffMode.Name;w.path=wake:GetFullName()
  w.position={wake.Parent.Position.X,wake.Parent.Position.Y,wake.Parent.Position.Z}
  if wake.IsPlaying then
   w.listenerDistance=(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position-wake.Parent.Position).Magnitude
   if m then for _,sound in m.Root:GetChildren() do if sound:IsA("Sound") and (sound:GetAttribute("audio_role") or ""):sub(1,14)=="monster_voice_" and sound.IsPlaying then data.voiceOverlap=true end end end
  end
 end
 data.duration=at
 report.Value=game.HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
 task.wait(.1)
end
if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
data.done=true
report.Value=game.HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
script:Destroy()
]]
